answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 42681 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Ihram Question: I live in Yanbu 400 km away from Makkah. Alhamdulillah, I have performed Hajj this year and returned just on Thursday. Now I have to go again Makkah for work -Job Interview can I go without Ihram to Makkah because now my intension is not for Umrah. So can I go to directly in job office and there after go to tawaf. Answer ID: 42681 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1729/1729/M=1434) It is not lawful for you to enter in Makkah without wearing ihram whether you intend to perform Hajj and Umrah or not. ولا يجوز للآفاقي أن يدخل مكة بغير إحرام نوى النسك أو لا، ولو دخلها فعليه حجة أو عمرة’ كذا في محيط السرخسي في باب دخول مكتة بغير أحرام. (الهندية 1/245’ كتاب المناسك، الباب الثانى في المواقيت). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
